correctness.rationale: The eight exact coefficient identities determine every fiber by degree. No fiber contains a curve, so proper quasi-finiteness plus birationality yields the finite normalization. Two exact determinant certificates establish immersion away from the sole source point above the linear polynomial, and the local-ring Nakayama argument makes all uniquely covered immersed target points smooth. Two normalization preimages force the entire other singular-line support. Tangent-space intersection is verified by a nonzero symbolic minor; the exceptional inverse-image crossing has an explicit local chart. The bundled Python/SymPy checker was run and passed. All claims are in characteristic zero.
